visualCharacteristics.purpose: page-opening hero: full-width photo (optional ambient Brightcove video) with a white overlay card holding the breadcrumb or story back link + meta row, the H1 and the lede
visualCharacteristics.layout: photo band with large top-left radius; white card overlaps its bottom edge, content in a 10-of-12 column
visualCharacteristics.notes: Story-article pages replace the breadcrumb with an "All Stories" back link and add a date / category / reading-time row; classified by content, no option class.

contentPattern.structure: rows classified by content: <picture> poster; optional Brightcove player URL paragraph; <ul> breadcrumb (linked ancestors, current page last) OR a back-link paragraph plus meta paragraphs (date, category, "N Minute Read"); <h1> then the lede paragraph(s)

usage: First section of content and story pages.
reuseGuidance: Use for every page-opening photo hero. Omit the player URL for image-only heroes; use the back-link + meta paragraphs for story articles instead of the breadcrumb.
